lines.say: blocks angiotensin II's AT1 receptor in vessel walls and the adrenal gland
partly activates PPAR-gamma, a receptor involved in metabolism (lab studies)
matched the ACE inhibitor ramipril on heart and stroke events in 25,620 high-risk people
didn't significantly beat placebo on its main outcome in 5,926 high-risk people
less belly fat, not fat under the skin, in 15 small trials in high blood pressure
potassium and kidney function checked; potassium can rise and kidney function change
boxed warning: drugs like it can injure or kill a developing baby
blood pressure can drop too low, especially when low on salt or fluids

ask: What would telmisartan do for me if my blood pressure is normal?
